name: dry-faults
description: The failure-path exercise (acceptance 8): the February ten through A, B, C and C-diag with faults injected into the MOCK Recognition calls (never possible on a paid run). The semantic validator is forced to fail on S1 and to answer unreadably on S2; the classifier answers unreadably on H1 and quotes words that are not in the draft on H2. Every failure must be counted and none regenerated.
